ὁμιλέω: to be in company with, consort with
ὁμολογέω: agree, say the same thing as
ὁρμέω: to be moored, lie at anchor
ὑπέχω: to hold under, uphold; undergo, suffer, be accountable
ὑπαγκαλίζω: to clasp in the arms, embrace
ὑπαποκινέω: to move off secretly, sneak away from
ὑπεξαντλέω: to drain out from below, exhaust
ὑπερέχω: to hold sth over or above sth; to excel, outdo
ὑπερβάλλω: to throw over; outdo, surpass, postpone
ὑπερφέρω: to bear or carry over, transfer; to surpass, excel
ὑπερφρονέω: to be over-proud, to have high thoughts
ὑπηρετέω: to do service on board ship, to do rower’s service
ὑποβάλλω: throw, put, lay under; bring in as one’s own
ὑπολαμβάνω: take up; understand, interpret; assume; reply, rejoin
ὑποτέμνω: to cut away under, cut away
ὑφάπτω: to set on fire from underneath
ὠδίνω: to be in labor, give birth; to be in pain
ὠθέω: to thrust, push, shove, force onwards
ὠφελέω: to help, aid, assist, to be of use
ῥέπω: to incline downwards, to sink, fall
ῥαθαπυγίζω: to give one a slap on the buttocks
ῥοφέω: to sup greedily up, gulp down
